web_events.query: China PMI economic data this week
web_events.answer: China's August economic data showed mixed results. The HSBC Flash China Manufacturing PMI rose to 50.6, indicating a slight improvement from July's 48.0. However, the official non-manufacturing PMI remained below the 50 threshold at 49.0, suggesting ongoing contraction in the services sector. Retail sales in July grew by just 0.6% year-over-year, falling short of expectations and signaling weak consumer demand.
